title: Distorted handheld

complaints.says: The announcements sound crunchy and distorted, even when I talk quietly.

win.label: Host clean in the mains
win.hint: The Handheld receiver's output is set to Line. Set it to Mic.

hints: Distortion that doesn't depend on how loud someone talks happens before the fader. Look at the receiver and the preamp.
cause: The handheld receiver's output was set to Line, about 30 dB hotter than the Mic level the preamp gain was set for, so the preamp clipped.
lesson: Match a receiver's output level to how the preamp is set. Line level into a mic-level gain setting will distort.
